item.coloph: zhes tshan gtor ro // bsnal bsang ngo // lo phrom kyi dmar tshan rdzogs so …
item.note: the words brnal and bsnal found above ought to be read as mnol, a kind of pollution that is overcome by bsangs rituals. for the term dmar tshan, see the above-mentioned article by karmay, p. 173, et passim.
